python3 << 'EOF'
# Data from the Treasury Bulletins - End of period balances for tax and loan accounts
# (in millions of dollars)

# 1962-1963 (July 1962 - January 1963) from 1963 bulletin
fy_1962_63 = [5528, 4637, 4770, 7342, 3841, 5374, 4206]

# 1963-1964 (July 1963 - January 1964) from 1964 bulletin
fy_1963_64 = [6730, 5350, 5765, 6813, 4022, 4792, 4995]

# 1964-1965 (July 1964 - January 1965) from 1965 bulletin
fy_1964_65 = [6519, 4514, 4880, 6434, 3394, 6699, 4198]

def compute_percentage(balances):
    max_val = max(balances)
    min_val = min(balances)
    range_val = max_val - min_val
    avg_val = sum(balances) / len(balances)
    pct = (range_val / avg_val) * 100
    return range_val, avg_val, pct

# Calculate for each fiscal year span
range_62_63, avg_62_63, pct_62_63 = compute_percentage(fy_1962_63)
range_63_64, avg_63_64, pct_63_64 = compute_percentage(fy_1963_64)
range_64_65, avg_64_65, pct_64_65 = compute_percentage(fy_1964_65)

print("1962-1963 (July-January):")
print(f"  Max: {max(fy_1962_63)}, Min: {min(fy_1962_63)}")
print(f"  Range: {range_62_63}")
print(f"  Average: {avg_62_63:.2f}")
print(f"  Range as % of average: {pct_62_63:.2f}%")
print()

print("1963-1964 (July-January):")
print(f"  Max: {max(fy_1963_64)}, Min: {min(fy_1963_64)}")
print(f"  Range: {range_63_64}")
print(f"  Average: {avg_63_64:.2f}")
print(f"  Range as % of average: {pct_63_64:.2f}%")
print()

print("1964-1965 (July-January):")
print(f"  Max: {max(fy_1964_65)}, Min: {min(fy_1964_65)}")
print(f"  Range: {range_64_65}")
print(f"  Average: {avg_64_65:.2f}")
print(f"  Range as % of average: {pct_64_65:.2f}%")
print()

percentages = [pct_62_63, pct_63_64, pct_64_65]
highest = max(percentages)
print(f"Highest percentage: {highest:.2f}%")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(highest, 2)}")
EOF
